text: The code complies with both stated contracts. The `energy` function correctly enforces strictly ordered run-relative monotonic timestamps by raising an error if `t1 <= t0` (line 120), rejecting unordered inputs without sorting. The `estimate` function implements whole-session cluster resampling via `rng.choices(clusters, ...)` (line 69), preserving the integrity of session clusters. It applies equal weight per pair by aggregating all values from selected clusters into a single list for the reducer (line 69), rather than weighting by session size. No defects are found regarding these specific requirements.
